title: Compiled Step at a Program Node
statement: Let $P$ be a register program, $D$ a decider, and $q_0$ a choice of initial decider state for each decider index. If a configuration $c$ of $P$ is at state $l$ and $l$ is not a call node, then one step of the machine compiled from $P$ and $D$, started from the configuration obtained by extending $c$ with idle decider tapes and marking its state as the program state $l$, equals the extension of the configuration reached by one step of $P$'s ordinary machine at $c$.
hypotheses_covered: program, decider, and initial decider states are given
